name: conditioned_step_teacher_v1
taskAdaptation: reference-conditioned direct-torque SAC teacher; source equations/presets remain separately immutable

observation.teacherInitialization: copy old physical columns 0:67; old power column67 to117; reference columns67:117 exactly zero; fresh critics

timing.transitionBoundary: freeze pre-action reference and phase for the executed interval reward; evaluate actual events afterward; next observation alone uses any new phase
timing.recording: explicit initial row plus post-action rows; equal-length qpos28/qvel27/com3/com_ori3; actual qualified WEAK records only for SLOW
timing.partialRequests: verified finite1..19-sample physical terminal transitions are retained with not_done0, dense/control costs scaled by actual duration/25ms and fixed failure penalty; interrupted/unverified/admin partial requests are excluded; corrupt/nonfinite final tensors abort collection

action.teacherUnits: normalized original motor torque, actuator order
action.gearScaling: original gear exactly once; no mass/friction/gear curriculum

phaseGates.finalQuietRule: FINAL4000 consecutive actual integrations through declared terminal ID; original native standing predicate plus measured tilt<=5deg; no longest-window substitution
phaseGates.supportGeometry: only actual measured contacts; geometric potential is never credited before touchdown

reward.formula: weighted mean of exp(-0.5*mean((error/scale)^2)) terms minus costs, plus ordered one-time actual event bonuses
reward.partialPhysicalTerminalRule: dense and normalized effort/change costs scaled by count/20, actual measured slip cost retained, no event bonus, full physicalFailurePenalty; no bootstrap
reward.measurementReduction: post-interval measured finite endpoint errors against the pre-action held target/reference twist; controls are actual normalized actuator controls at the post-interval boundary (and previous boundary for change cost), never held student residuals; slip is sum of actual per-foot cumulative increments; events use all consecutive native samples
reward.rotationConvention: world-frame SO(3) geodesic rotvec Log(R_actual*R_target.T), radians, normalized rotations; no Euler-component subtraction
reward.loadedSlipReduction: sum of nonnegative actual per-foot cumulative loaded-slip increments; not maximum; no reset within episode
reward.controlCostUnits: actual normalized actuator controls in both teacher and student; never student residual radians

errorFrames.hipSpeedErrorRadps: actual hinge dq[5,11] minus admitted phase-clock reference dq[5,11]
errorFrames.comHeightErrorM: actual native worldY COM minus target true COM height
errorFrames.torsoVerticalError: actual source-order torso-local worldup minus FK target vector3
errorFrames.leftFootPositionErrorM: actual minus target native WORLD XYZ foot-origin3
errorFrames.leftFootRotationErrorRad: world-frame SO3 geodesic rotvec Log(R_actual R_target.T)
errorFrames.wholeFootClearanceErrorM: actual min of both endpoints on both capsules minus target same geometry
errorFrames.signedForwardErrorM: actual signed foot displacement against fixed entry heading minus target signed displacement
errorFrames.comVelocityErrorMps: actual source-order world COM velocity minus phase-clock reference source-order velocity3

termination.truncationObservation: actual final observation/reference, never reset observation
physicalFailures: COM outside original safety height envelope
termination.flightDefinition: both measured foot normal loads<3N in any native sample
termination.timeouts: intrinsic phase wall/goal deadline is terminal0 with failure penalty; extrinsic pilot physics/wall/collection cutoff truncates with actual final state and bootstrap1; interrupted/unverified request excluded
termination.terminalSuccess: quietComplete is an explicitly absorbing successful task terminal (not_done0), unlike source fixed N+150 truncation; no failure penalty; full actual final observation retained
termination.invalidObservation: nonfinite/corrupt observations abort/save collection, never replay invalid tensors

curriculum.reduceOnlyAfter: ten consecutive deterministic full physical acceptance trials at the current fixed power; all pass; no source return60 threshold

pilot.warmupBehavior: frozen initializer plus Gaussian std0.02 normalized control clipped to power bounds
pilot.afterWarmupBehavior: current pinned source stochastic actor; logstd[-5,2], unchanged SAC sampling
pilot.stopRollback: any known quiet/GetUp regression or failed paired safety check; no blind retuning
pilot.resourceLedger: session-20261017T223404Z; <=300s new aggregate physics and deadline23:34:04UTC; stage ceilings/reserve unchanged
pilot.hashAdmission: future runner must match externally pinned expected config SHA256 and task/reference/native/actor code hashes BEFORE collection; computing the current hash alone is not admission
